defaultTransport: global fetch captured at factory creation
applicationTransport: Explicit injected Fetch-compatible function is trusted application code

perInvocation.request: Fresh owned clean request; sign final serialized method/URL and stable headers
perInvocation.native421: Native Fetch may resend identical signed bytes after 421; no new nonce is issued by the wrapper

collisions.check: Check input Request and init headers separately before overrides; even empty values reject

body.explicitEmptyBody: A non-null body still requires opt-in

destination.ports: Absent default or decimal integer 1 through 65535
destination.rawString: Validate HTTP exception before URL normalization
destination.preconstructed: Validate serialized URL/Request address only; original spelling is unrecoverable

redirects.inheritedRequestMode: Replace with manual on the owned request, including Request's default follow
redirects.response: Return selected transport response without wrapper follow or retry

stableCoverage: Do not guess transport-generated fields; unsupported absent additional coverage rejects through the existing signer

abort.afterDispatch: No proof that server did not receive request
abort.diagnostic: Fixed AbortError text, never caller abort reason

errors.wrapperValidation: Fixed TypeError without raw input or cause
errors.transportFailure: Fixed TypeError without raw backend error or cause
errors.signerFailure: Preserve existing SigningError code without raw provider failures

comparison: Golden byte equality at the selected transport Request boundary; not TCP header ordering or transport-added headers
